entries.rationale: The candidate's own drive selection after the curve, under a new id so the amp switch can take the id it fed.

saturation.ampSim's cabinet for cab_model 0, as cab_voicing designs it with no microphone and presence at its 0 dB default: a Butterworth high-pass, the body peak and a fourth-order Butterworth roll-off. The one place an overlay holds numbers; tests/midi/gs_classic_types_other_test.cpp holds these sections to design_cab_stage.
